title: Nostalgic Syrian Lamb Stew
description: A traditional Syrian lamb stew flavored with herbs and black pepper, cooked in a cazuela with lardons-render for added richness, this dish is a flexitarian-friendly delight
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the cazuela over medium heat
Add the lardons and cook until rendered and crispy
Remove the lardons from the cazuela and set aside
Add the lamb to the cazuela and cook until browned on all sides
Add the onion and garlic to the cazuela and cook until the onion is translucent
Add the thyme, rosemary, and black pepper to the cazuela and cook for 1 minute
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, and browned lamb to the cazuela
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours
Stir in the rendered lardons and cook for an additional 30 minutes
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
